newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi awards 597.7 million riyal aviation contract.
newsitem.headline: Saudi awards 597.7 million riyal aviation contract.

text.p: A Saudi Arabian firm has won a 597.7 million riyal contract to operate and maintain the kingdom's civil aviation systems and airports, a Saudi newspaper said on Monday.
The three-year contract also covers maintenance of airport lounges, runways and other services, water desalination and electricity plants and spare parts, the English-language Arab News added.
Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Prince Sultan signed the contract on Sunday. The newspaper did not name the company.
